defective_pattern: Stripping '<w:jc>' tags or assuming implicit right alignment for Persian headings.
why_defective: Causes headings to inherit left-alignment from the Normal style, leading to incorrect display in Word.
observed_symptoms: Headings aligned to the left in Persian documents.
corrective_remedy: Provide explicit '<w:jc w:val="right"/>' injection for all Persian headings, specifically when alignment is set to right.

detection_heuristic.trigger_rule: Absence of explicit '<w:jc w:val="right"/>' element when heading alignment is meant to be right or RTL.
